_note: App Store 'What's New' per locale for the CURRENT release. Bump `version` + all notes each release (keep in sync with CHANGELOG's store note). The CI ios_prepare job (tools/asc_prepare_version.py) only writes these when `version` matches the build's MARKETING_VERSION, so stale notes are never shipped. Keys are App Store Connect locale codes.

notes.en-US: Bug fix: on iPhone, the "Rate on Store" button now opens the app's real App Store page instead of a broken link.
notes.tr: Hata düzeltmesi: iPhone'da "Mağazada Puanla" düğmesi artık bozuk bir bağlantı yerine uygulamanın gerçek App Store sayfasını açıyor.
notes.ar: إصلاح خلل: على iPhone، أصبح زر «قيّم على المتجر» يفتح الآن صفحة التطبيق الحقيقية في App Store بدلاً من رابط معطّل.
